mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ct_gm.t_pu_order(dept_id, po_no, order_id, prod_plan_id, supplier_id, po_type, po_date, expect_arrive_date, qty_total, amount, tax_rate, amount_tax, qty_received, status, stock_in_no, buyer_id, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by, is_del) VALUES (#{entity.deptId}, #{entity.poNo}, #{entity.orderId}, #{entity.prodPlanId}, #{entity.supplierId}, #{entity.poType}, #{entity.poDate}, #{entity.expectArriveDate}, #{entity.qtyTotal}, #{entity.amount}, #{entity.taxRate}, #{entity.amountTax}, #{entity.qtyReceived}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.stockInNo}, #{entity.buyerId}, #{entity.remark}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_gm.t_pu_order SET dept_id=#{entity.deptId}, order_id=#{entity.orderId}, prod_plan_id=#{entity.prodPlanId}, supplier_id=#{entity.supplierId}, po_type=#{entity.poType}, po_date=#{entity.poDate}, expect_arrive_date=#{entity.expectArriveDate}, qty_total=#{entity.qtyTotal}, amount=#{entity.amount}, tax_rate=#{entity.taxRate}, amount_tax=#{entity.amountTax}, qty_received=#{entity.qtyReceived}, status=#{entity.status}, stock_in_no=#{entity.stockInNo}, buyer_id=#{entity.buyerId}, remark=#{entity.remark}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE po_id = #{entity.id} AND is_del = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ct_gm.t_pu_order WHERE po_no=#{poNo} AND is_del=0 AND po_id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_gm.t_pu_order SET qty_total=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_pu_order_item WHERE po_id = #{poId} AND is_del = 0), amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_pu_order_item WHERE po_id = #{poId} AND is_del = 0), amount_tax=ROUND( (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_pu_order_item WHERE po_id = #{poId} AND is_del = 0) * (1 + tax_rate), 2), updated_at=NOW() WHERE po_id = #{poId} AND is_del = 0
